input: Committed 2023-25 detail context arrays and original five-session execution tape, 22 instruments, same observed decision grid. No prior expert predictions as inputs. Text means recorded event sentiment features, not raw documents.
split: Refit all parameters from scratch in two chronological folds: 2023 training, 2024 scoring; 2023 and 2024 training, 2025 scoring. Require all training endpoints strictly before first test decision. All feature scaling uses training rows. Each trailing eight-observation numerical sequence ends at the decision date within a stock and calendar year; repeat the earliest available observation to pad shortened windows.
model: Eight-dimensional numerical GRU over six fields; eight-dimensional tanh MLP over three dated Fed, headline and filing sentiment fields; three-class linear model over four market fields; eight-unit tanh context gate with simplex output over all three experts. Joint end-to-end categorical loss plus 0.2 times mean head categorical loss for expert supervision. Fixed seed 28, AdamW learning rate 0.002, weight decay 0.01, 12 epochs, shuffled minibatches of 256. No search, early stopping, calibration, or selection.
contrast: Single primary contrast: joint contextual vote minus a uniform vote of exactly the same three trained experts in daily mean log loss. Averaging exactly the same heads tests the incremental value of routing at inference conditional on joint training. Report paired 95% circular block bootstrap within each evaluation year, block 21 sessions, 2000 draws, seed 28.
execution: Registered shared portfolio replay with original signal threshold, position limits, fees and annual liquidation. Economic comparisons and individual model results descriptive. Report peer investable portfolio values on same dates via existing site ledgers. Retrospective previously inspected years.
